title: Soluble epoxide hydrolase as a target in hypertension
abstract: Inhibition of sEH stabilizes epoxyeicosatrienoic acids and lowers blood pressure in rodent models. Aryl-urea scaffolds show nanomolar potency.

title: Arylpropionate anti-inflammatories and off-target sEH activity
abstract: Several NSAIDs exhibit weak sEH inhibition. Lipophilicity correlates with potency across the arylpropionate series.
